Ordinary API/worker execution selects the prepared Counterdex runtime. Restricted Deep Agents callbacks use controlled model decisions and authoritative scientific facts; ordinary-user execution, process cleanup and zero provider dispatch are checked separately. Live Gemini remains disabled.

A computed baseline pair feeds a separately approved finite-grid design with exact tier, allowance provenance, horizon and budget. Numerical requests remain unchecked; no separation is a useful negative result for the selected pair.

Package and ordinary HTTP checks exercise strict positive margins, horizon admission, expected binding and native evidence for two fixed candidates. These predicates establish neither global optimality nor exclusion of every other parameter vector.

Downloaded application-native packets replay in a separately prepared CPython 3.11 process against complete external anchors. This is fresh execution of the same checker, not an independent proof implementation. Browser replay remains unsupported.
